question: What worries or excites you about where AI is going?

add.desc: Sky backdrop over the whole top of the frame down to the horizon at y 560. d dims and greys it, b warms it.
Green meadow from the horizon y 560 to the bottom with a pale path. d browns it and cracks it, b brings flowers.
Large rolling hill on the right horizon, x 900-1600, a quiet place for a future building. d withers it, b adds trees.
Old stone clock tower on the left at x 280, base y 580. decay boards and cracks it; bloom lights windows and paints it. Its hands turn.
Pond in the middle foreground, centre x 860, y 740. decay shrinks and dulls it; bloom adds lilies and a bright sheen.
A few villagers strolling to and fro across the meadow foreground, y 860. They hurry in wind and gather with bond.

patch.note: A quiet village meadow with an old clock tower, a still pond, a green hill and a few walkers, mostly empty and ready to be changed.

answers: there will be data centres everywhere
I think it will make life better

draw.brief: Rewrite the hill: it is now crowded with several big pale windowless data centre slabs set into its slopes along the right horizon, x 900-1600, with a few small humming lights and heat shimmer. Mood mixed: sleek but a little imposing. Fences and cables run down toward the meadow. Number 'build' sets how many slabs and how large; decay makes them grey and stained, bloom adds green roofs and lit slits.

Rewrite the pond and move it left-centre, x 450-900 and no longer overlapping the walkers. A playful friendly long-necked dinosaur stands in the water, 300px tall, drinking and slowly swinging its neck, with ripples. Decay shrinks the water and makes the dinosaur gaunt; bloom adds lilies and a bright sheen.

Rewrite the walkers: move them to the lower strip y 820-880, clear of the pond. Some villagers walk briskly with coats, but a few stand idle in a loose group with empty hands and slumped shoulders, looking up at the data centre hill. Number 'idle' sets the fraction standing still; decay bows them, bloom gives them tools and company.

patch.note: The quiet meadow now has dinosaurs at the pond, data centres swelling over the hill, and villagers left idle beneath them, with a hopeful clock tower still keeping time.

add.desc: Villagers on the lower strip y 820-880: some stroll briskly, a loose idle group on the right stands slumped, looking up at the data centre hill. idle = fraction standing still.

Right-horizon hill x 900-1600 with pale windowless data centre slabs in its slopes, fences and cables running to the meadow. build sets slab count and size; decay stains, bloom greens roofs and lights slits.
Pond at left-centre x 450-900, y 740 with a friendly long-necked dinosaur standing in it, drinking. Decay shrinks water and makes it gaunt; bloom adds lilies and sheen.

draw.brief: Rewrite the opening hill so the data centres sprawl: a second and third tier of huge pale windowless slabs spill down the slopes and across to x 700, fenced, with cables and pipes running to the meadow. Mood grim and oversized, with slits glowing in a steady pulse. build sets the slab count and size; decay stains, bloom greens the roofs.

Rewrite the villagers on the lower strip: every walker now wears a different absurd hat (cone, top, party, crown) in a playful mood. On the left, a few chunky friendly boxy robots do the chores (hoeing the path and carrying crates) while a slumped idle group on the right watches, one fidgeting anxiously with a cap in hand. idle sets the fraction standing still; decay makes them bow, bloom makes them gather.

Rewrite the meadow so the left-centre has neatly tilled furrows and a worn track where the robots work, while the right side near the hill is trampled bare and fenced. Decay browns and cracks it, bloom adds flowers along the furrows.

patch.note: Robots tend the meadow in funny hats while the data centres swell over the hill and idle villagers worry about their jobs.

add.desc: Meadow from horizon y560 down: tilled furrows left-centre with a worn robot track, trampled fenced bare earth on the right near the hill. Decay browns and cracks; bloom flowers the furrows.
Hill at right, now sprawling tiers of huge windowless slabs spilling left to x 700, fenced, with cables and pipes to the meadow. build = slab size; decay stains, bloom greens roofs.
Lower strip y 780-890: hatted villagers stroll, boxy robots hoe the path and carry crates on the left, slumped idle group on the right. idle = fraction standing still.
